fusions.name: Headsman's Due
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% health and deals 24 damage, plus 1.6 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which are used up.

fusions.name: Worry the Cut
fusions.desc: Snaps through a cone 2 tiles ahead and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance each to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. It deals 8% more for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Cut Loose
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 10 seconds and your movement speed by 20% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Blooded
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
